dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What exactly is the "Snow Alley Dash"?

dialogues.speaker: Inna
dialogues.text: Haha, it's a little sport I invented myself! It doesn't take much skill, you can play as long as you know how to run.

dialogues.speaker: Inna
dialogues.text: In a freezing place like this, my hair is practically turning into icicles... But let me tell you, running one round of it warms you up better than a whole flask of strong liquor!
